items.title: Avery "Kid" Howard Interview, 1958-12-22
items.q: Nobody like Lloyd after me. That's my man. That's my man.

ctx.x: In regard to the old time trombone, who was your favorite? Of course, it's hard to pick one person. Who were the, of all the fellows you've ever heard in your life on trumpet, who did you like best? Probably, I know you talked about doing Armstrong, you just mentioned. Oh yeah. Would he be your favorite or are there other fellows?
No, no. Nobody like Lloyd after me. That's my man. That's my man.
And most people would say that I think too.
